description: Check a real estate investment deal against Quanta Finance's published loan terms. Returns a verdict (fits, resize, review or does_not_work), the largest loan the published terms allow, follow-up questions and the next step. A verdict needs the property's state; without one the result is needs_state. The next step includes quoteUrl, a link that opens Quanta's quote form with the deal filled in. Each result is an estimate, not a loan approval or a commitment to lend, and starts with a notice that says so. Loans are for business purposes on non-owner-occupied investment property only.

downPayment.description: Cash the borrower puts toward the purchase in USD, when stated

entity.description: How the borrower will take title

holdback.description: Loan amount held back for the rehab in USD, when stated

initialLoan.description: Loan amount at closing toward the purchase in USD, when stated

loanAmount.description: Total loan amount in USD the person asked for, if they named one

ownerOccupied.description: true if the borrower plans to live in the property

projectType.description: Program slug that fits the project

projectsLast3Years.description: Similar projects completed in the last 3 years

propertyState.description: Two-letter US state code of the property, DC for Washington DC. A verdict needs it.

purchaseLoanPercent.description: Share of the purchase price the loan covers at closing, as the stated percent, such as 65.28

purchasePrice.description: Purchase price in USD, or current value for a refinance

rehabBudget.description: Rehab or construction budget in USD

rehabLoanPercent.description: Share of the rehab the loan covers, as the stated percent

name: check_deal_fit
title: Check a deal
